column5: Concurrent uploads of the same file can cause intermittent 500 responses
column9: Reproduced on latest main (d27ad23): a second upload of the same object while the first is still in flight fails with 'open <oid>.tmp: file exists' -> HTTP 500, and PutHandler then deletes the object's metadata (GET meta -> 404) even though the first upload succeeds. Cause: ContentStore.Put uses one fixed temp path opened with O_EXCL. Deterministic repro test fails 20/20; a per-upload temp file (os.CreateTemp) fixes it and the existing suite stays green. No PRs filed since this issue (it is the newest number in the repo) and none of the 8 open PRs touch this code. Caveats: Go, low-activity repo (last merge 2025-12-16), and go test -race can't run because boltdb v1.3.1 trips checkptr.
